title: Gharnāṭa keeps the honours of a capital. The old seat of the house of Naṣr is recognised as the realm's historical capital, and the court of al-Ḥamrāʾ keeps its full weight: the fortress its strength, the crown its power, the realm its culture and legitimacy

data.ooc: The game recorded no historical capital when the capital moved to Seville in November 1379 (likely because of the Al-Andalus formation), which left al-Ḥamrāʾ inactive. Trent restored it from the console on 3 May 1380 with set_capital to Granada and straight back to Seville; the save of 3 May 1380 shows historical_capitals={2894}.

source: save of 3 May 1380; Trent's console fix
